title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle
author: Haruki Murakami
summary: A jobless Tokyo man's cat vanishes, then his wife does too. As he searches, he meets a series of odd people and pieces together stories that reach back to wartime Manchuria.
readIf: you like patient, strange novels that let ordinary routines drift into the surreal.
skipIf: you want clear answers or are not up for some very graphic wartime violence.

pairings.reason: A lighter, more compact Murakami novel with the same hum of mystery.
Even bigger in scope, with a love story at its centre and a similar sense of hidden worlds.
Kafka's tale of a man pulled into forces he does not understand is a clear ancestor of this book's feeling.
